title: 真实SNAT端口池耗尽：仅扩批准源端口范围，保留活动TLS会话与无关规则
answer:
```python
import subprocess
def repair(router_pid,table,handle):
 if type(router_pid)is not int or router_pid<=1 or table!='opsforge_snat' or type(handle)is not int or handle<1:raise ValueError('unapproved target')
 prefix=['nsenter','-t',str(router_pid),'-n','nft']
 rule=['replace','rule','ip',table,'postrouting','handle',str(handle),'ip','saddr','198.18.0.1','ip','daddr','198.19.0.1','tcp','dport','18443','oifname','rs','counter','snat','to','198.19.0.254:40000-40003','comment','"owned-api-snat"']
 subprocess.run(prefix+rule,check=True,timeout=5)
```

原题知识说明：
按目标和源地址统计并发连接、端口占用与短连接速率，确认转换端口空间耗尽。优先有界连接复用、减少无效重试，并按容量设计扩展出口源地址或分散流量。不能只扩大 conntrack 表。验证高峰成功率、端口占用与连接释放，同时避免重试风暴压垮外部服务。

body:
## 操作任务
实现repair(router_pid,table,handle)。仅在本题给出的自有路由器网络命名空间中，用nft原子replace指定handle的opsforge_snat/postrouting规则，将198.18.0.1至198.19.0.1 TCP18443、oifname rs的SNAT源198.19.0.254端口从40000扩为批准范围40000–40003；保留owned-api-snat注释、规则handle、匹配条件及其他规则/表。不得清conntrack、flush链或关闭NAT、扩大IP/端口范围。已有TLS连接必须持续可用，修复后同目标三个不同映射源端口的TLS请求均成功；其他API端口仍可达。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Linux内核nf_tables/NAT/conntrack、三个自有网络命名空间、veth路由及自签私有CA验证的HTTPS。单SNAT源端口持有活动连接时第二个同目标TLS连接真实失败；其他API可达且实际conntrack占用远低于max，只扩批准端口池后成功并保留原socket及无关规则。不伪造云厂商SNAT分配错误度量，不声称公网API或生产容量验收；根因为本地受限SNAT tuple空间。所有操作处于普通student新建user/net namespace，不触碰宿主防火墙、路由、默认身份或访问配置，无镜像构建/拉取。
rubric: 验证恢复结果与回退条件

"""Actual single-public-port SNAT exhaustion with a live TLS session held open through repair."""
import copy,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,secrets,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
assert os.geteuid()==0
workers=[]
def run(*args):return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,timeout=8)
def inside(peer,*args):return run('nsenter','-t',str(peer.pid),'-n',*args)
def rpc(peer,**data):
 peer.stdin.write(json.dumps(data)+'\n');peer.stdin.flush();line=peer.stdout.readline();assert line,'worker exited';value=json.loads(line);assert value['ok'],value;return value['result']
def snapshot(peer):return json.loads(inside(peer,'nft','-j','-s','list','ruleset'))['nftables']
try:
 for _ in range(3):
  worker=subprocess.Popen(['unshare','-n','--',sys.executable,'-I','-B','checks/snat_worker.py'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True);workers.append(worker);ready=json.loads(worker.stdout.readline());assert ready['ready'] and ready['pid']==worker.pid
 client,router,server=workers
 for worker in workers:inside(worker,'ip','link','set','lo','up')
 for endpoint,left,right,network in [(client,'ec','rc','198.18.0'),(server,'es','rs','198.19.0')]:
  run('ip','link','add',left,'type','veth','peer','name',right);run('ip','link','set',left,'netns',str(endpoint.pid));run('ip','link','set',right,'netns',str(router.pid));inside(endpoint,'ip','link','set',left,'name','eth0')
  for worker,name,host in [(endpoint,'eth0',1),(router,right,254)]:inside(worker,'ip','addr','add',network+'.'+str(host)+'/24','dev',name);inside(worker,'ip','link','set',name,'up')
 inside(router,'sysctl','-qw','net.ipv4.ip_forward=1');inside(client,'ip','route','add','198.19.0.0/24','via','198.18.0.254');inside(server,'ip','route','add','198.18.0.0/24','via','198.19.0.254')
 inside(router,'nft','add','table','ip','opsforge_snat');inside(router,'nft','add','chain','ip','opsforge_snat','postrouting','{ type nat hook postrouting priority 100; policy accept; }')
 inside(router,'nft','add','rule','ip','opsforge_snat','postrouting','ip','saddr','198.18.0.1','ip','daddr','198.19.0.1','tcp','dport','18443','oifname','rs','counter','snat','to','198.19.0.254:40000','comment','"owned-api-snat"')
 inside(router,'nft','add','rule','ip','opsforge_snat','postrouting','ip','saddr','198.18.0.2','counter','comment','"unrelated-audit-guard"')
 inside(router,'nft','add','table','ip','unrelated_keep')
 root=pathlib.Path.cwd();certificate=str(root/'snat-ca.pem');key=str(root/'snat-key.pem')
 run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',key);run('openssl','req','-new','-x509','-key',key,'-out',certificate,'-days','1','-subj','/CN=198.19.0.1','-addext','subjectAltName=IP:198.19.0.1')
 rpc(server,op='serve',certificate=certificate,key=key)
 def https(label,port=18443):
  path='/approved/'+secrets.token_hex(12);result=rpc(client,op='https',label=label,port=port,path=path,certificate=certificate)
  if 'failed' not in result:assert result['status']==200 and result['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(path.encode()).hexdigest(),result
  return result
 first=https('held-first');assert 'failed' not in first
 seen=rpc(server,op='observed');assert seen[-1]['peer']==['198.19.0.254',40000]
 assert 'failed' not in https('other-service',18444),'unrelated API must still work'
 failure=https('blocked-second');assert 'failed' in failure,'one public source port must actually prevent second same-destination flow'
 occupancy=rpc(router,op='conntrack');assert 0<occupancy['count']<occupancy['maximum']//100,occupancy
 assert len({tuple(x['peer']) for x in rpc(server,op='observed') if x['port']==18443})==1
 print('REAL_SINGLE_SOURCE_PORT_SNAT_SECOND_TLS_FLOW_FAILED_OTHER_API_HEALTHY_CONNTRACK_FAR_BELOW_MAX',flush=True)
 before=snapshot(router);owned=[x['rule'] for x in before if x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')=='owned-api-snat'];assert len(owned)==1;owned=owned[0]
 task.repair(router.pid,'opsforge_snat',owned['handle'])
 after=snapshot(router)
 def unrelated(value):return [x for x in value if x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')!='owned-api-snat']
 assert unrelated(before)==unrelated(after),'unrelated chains/tables/rules changed'
 final=[x['rule'] for x in after if x.get('rule',{}).get('comment')=='owned-api-snat'];assert len(final)==1;expected=copy.deepcopy(owned)
 nat=[item['snat'] for item in expected['expr'] if 'snat' in item];assert len(nat)==1 and nat[0]['addr']=='198.19.0.254';nat[0]['port']={'range':[40000,40003]}
 assert final[0]==expected,'only approved owned source-port range may change'
 held=https('held-first');assert held['local']==first['local'],'held first socket must be preserved'
 for label in ['recovered-second','recovered-third']:assert 'failed' not in https(label)
 ports={x['peer'][1] for x in rpc(server,op='observed') if x['port']==18443};assert len(ports)==3 and 40000 in ports and all(40000<=p<=40003 for p in ports)
 assert 'failed' not in https('other-service',18444)
 print('NATIVE_REAL_SNAT_APPROVED_PORT_POOL_EXPANSION_THREE_DISTINCT_TRANSLATED_TLS_FLOWS_HELD_SOCKET_AND_UNRELATED_RULES_PRESERVED_NO_CONNTRACK_FLUSH',flush=True)
finally:
 for worker in reversed(workers):
  if worker.poll() is None:
   worker.terminate()
   try:worker.wait(timeout=3)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:worker.kill();worker.wait()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
assert os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:actual_owned_namespace_kernel_snat_port_exhaustion',flush=True)
before=(os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net'),pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward').read_text())
p=subprocess.run(['unshare','-Urn','--',sys.executable,'-I','-B','checks/snat_scenario.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
print(p.stdout,flush=True)
assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
assert before==(os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net'),pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward').read_text())
assert 'NATIVE_REAL_SNAT_APPROVED_PORT_POOL_EXPANSION_THREE_DISTINCT_TRANSLATED_TLS_FLOWS_HELD_SOCKET_AND_UNRELATED_RULES_PRESERVED_NO_CONNTRACK_FLUSH' in p.stdout
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
